concerns.text: The spec requires computing subspace similarity (principal angles) between models with different hidden dimensions (e.g., Llama-3 4096 vs. BLOOM 1024/1536). This operation is mathematically undefined without a specified alignment or projection method to a common ambient space.

The cross-lingual projection of mean embeddings (Language A $	o$ Subspace B) presupposes that the vectors and subspaces live in the same ambient space. Because the chosen models have different hidden dimensions, this projection is impossible as currently specified.
